merkbox.usage: Past perfect: Was war zuerst? · Simple past: Was passierte danach?
merkbox.question: Had … + 3rd form?  ·  Did … + verb?

exercises.title: Make a sentence and fill in a suitable signal word.
Look at Josh's day. What had he done?

items.text: When Josh {} guitar lessons he {} already {} at school.
When he {} pizza he {} already {} guitar lessons.

items.text: The car {} (be) working because Dad {} (lose) his keys.
Paul {} (not/have) money for ice-cream because he {} (forget) to ask his mother.
After her cat {} (die) last Friday Ann {} (be) very sad.
I {} (not/want) to see the film because I {} (already/see) it.

exercises.title: Connect the 2 sentences using the words in brackets.

items.prompt: The robber broke into the house. Later he escaped through the window. (before)
Ann took a bath. She worked hard all day. (because)
The waitress served the food. The guests left the restaurant. (when …already)
I wrote a nice story. My teacher corrected it. (after)
I sent Mr Potter an e-mail. But he didn't aswer it. (which)
